description: Every official address in a Dutch postcode (alle adressen per postcode, BAG): street, house number, letter and addition, BAG object id and coordinates, sorted. For address pickers, door-to-door delivery and canvassing routes, data cleaning and real estate agents. Source: Kadaster BAG via PDOK. Costs 0.005 USDC via x402, or 3 credits of a Factline API key.
